body: I'm unsure this could work if you don't have `quarkus-resteasy-jaxb`. But still this is weird.
@ia3andy I think we need to understand where this NPE is coming from. Even if the configuration is invalid, we shouldn't throw a NPE, especially with nothing being logged.

1) I do have `quarkus-resteasy-jaxb` (see 2 in the original post)

2) My debugging research points me down to `AbstractJAXBProvider`. [This](https://github.com/resteasy/Resteasy/blob/master/providers/jaxb/src/main/java/org/jboss/resteasy/plugins/providers/jaxb/AbstractJAXBProvider.java#L76) returns `null`.
@gsmet sure I'll look into it tomorrow ;-)

@ia3andy my guess would be that we probably need to also consider `@Consumes` for `ContextResolvers` here: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/master/extensions/resteasy-common/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/resteasy/common/deployment/ResteasyCommonProcessor.java#L270 .
